name: ccra
description: Comprehensive code reviewer: whole-repo audits and change reviews driving open-code-review in delegate mode, ruff through reviewdog, and ponytail's review procedures. Works offline.

interface.shortDescription: Whole-repo audits and change reviews, offline.
interface.longDescription: Adds the ccra-audit and ccra-review skills. They run the bundled open-code-review CLI in delegate mode for file selection and rules, ruff through reviewdog for lint, and apply ponytail's audit and review procedures; the agent writes REVIEW.md.
defaultPrompt: Review my current changes with ccra-review.
Review this branch against main with ccra-review.
